help.title: Setup Guide
help.subtitle: Technical documentation for configuring Spotify, Last.fm, MusicBrainz, YouTube cookies, and Subsonic client connections.
help.youtube.title: YouTube Cookies
help.youtube.desc: Required to avoid "Sign in to confirm you're not a robot" error.
help.youtube.step1_desc: Install the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension in Chrome or Firefox.
help.youtube.step2_desc: Log into YouTube with your account, open the extension and click "Export". A cookies.txt file will download.
help.youtube.step3_desc: Go to Settings > Engine and upload the file.
help.spotify.title: Spotify API
help.spotify.desc: Enables high-quality metadata download and private Playlist reading.
help.spotify.step2_desc: Click "Create App". Name it (e.g., "Navipod"). In "Redirect URI" you can use http://localhost/callback.
help.spotify.step3_desc: Enter the created App, go to "Settings" and copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
help.lastfm.title: Last.fm API
help.lastfm.desc: Used for discovery, recommendations, metadata enrichment, and cover fallbacks.
help.lastfm.step1_desc: Open last.fm/api/account/create and register a new API application.
help.lastfm.step2_desc: Save the API Key. The Shared Secret is optional in Navipod and is only needed for signed Last.fm operations.
help.lastfm.step3_desc: Go to Settings > Engine, paste the key, and optionally add the shared secret.
help.musicbrainz.title: MusicBrainz
help.musicbrainz.desc: No API key is required. Navipod uses MusicBrainz for search, discovery, and metadata cross-matching.
help.musicbrainz.step1_desc: MusicBrainz search works without a personal API key, so there is nothing to configure in user settings.
help.musicbrainz.step2_desc: Open Search and enable the MusicBrainz source or include it in the global source mix.
help.musicbrainz.step3_desc: In Settings > Engine, set your metadata provider priority so MusicBrainz can participate in cover and track matching fallbacks.
help.apps.title: Mobile App Connection
help.apps.desc: Navipod uses the Subsonic protocol. You can connect any compatible player (iOS/Android) to stream your music remotely.
help.apps.note: Use the same password you use to log in here. Make sure to enable "Legacy Auth" if the app requests it.
help.offline.title: Offline Playback & Storage
help.offline.desc: Save tracks and playlists directly to your browser, phone, or APK wrapper for continuous playback without an internet connection.
help.offline.step1_desc: Tap the options menu (three dots) on any local song or use the "Download for Offline" button in any playlist header to save music locally.
help.offline.step2_desc: The initial ~2 GB shown in the browser estimate is a starting quota. When installed as a PWA ("Add to Home Screen") or in the Android APK, storage expands dynamically on demand up to your device's free disk space.
help.offline.step3_desc: Favorites, scrobbles, and playlist edits created while offline are queued locally and synchronized with the server automatically as soon as connectivity returns.
